title: EIT Higher Education Initiative – Call for Proposals 2026
summary: Funding for consortia led by higher education institutions to turn STEM talent, knowledge and research into deep-tech and manufacturing innovation and entrepreneurship. Projects work across talent development, institutional capacity for knowledge valorisation and innovation, and integration into innovation ecosystems.

conditions: Up to €1.25 million per project, for 18 months (1 May 2027 – 31 October 2028).
Consortium led by a higher education institution (HEI), with at least 5 partner organisations, all based in Horizon Europe eligible countries.
At least 3 HEIs from 3 different Horizon Europe eligible countries, one of them from an EU Member State.
At least 2 business or industry partners (networks and associations included).
Other eligible partners: research organisations, technology and knowledge transfer offices, public bodies, intermediary organisations, social enterprises and NGOs.
Applicants complete the HEInnovate self-assessment and an Innovation Vision Action Plan (IVAP). Results are announced in March 2027.
resources: Call text, FAQs, Part B template, budget template and KIC synergy documents.
The initiative's own matchmaking platform for Call 2026 consortia.
Proposals are submitted here, not in the Funding & Tenders Portal.
